_note: Hand-computed itineraries (specs/002 research R1-R2, ADR-0014) for hub ORD over 2026-01-05..2026-01-14 (10 days): min connection 30 (partner 45), max 240, recurrence 0.60, min sold passengers 30 against db1b_sample.csv. Itineraries are slot pairs; layover and travel are medians of daily scheduled values on connecting days.

excluded_examples.CMH-ORD-SEA:AA0800+AS0900: 40 min, below the 45 min partner minimum: never connects
excluded_examples.CMH-ORD-DEN:AA0800+AA1030: sold routing CMH:ORD:DEN AA:AA has 12 sampled passengers < 30

od_exclusions._note: Candidates: airline-compatible slot pairs through ORD, each slot scheduled on >= 60% of days.
